posts.text: Todd Haley isn’t there yet with claiming any of the quarterbacks on the roster will be the starter in 2027: “I'm not there, so I don't know. Generally speaking, unless it's a guy like Brock Purdy or Tom Brady, quarterbacks who aren't taken in the first round usually don't end up becoming franchise players. There's a reason guys like Will Howard and Drew Allar get drafted where they do. History tells us that's usually how it works. That doesn't mean there isn't another Kurt Warner out there, someone nobody saw coming who eventually becomes a Hall of Famer. But that's the exception, not the rule. Again, I'm not there. If I were sitting at practice every day, I could probably give you a much better answer. I saw things from both of them in college that I really liked, and I saw things I didn't like. At the end of the day, there's a reason they were drafted where they were.” #Steelers #NFL
